subject: Visibility add-ons: early-bird pricing and retention packaging
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlanehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procure@starlanehealth.com
Date: 2027-07-31T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: initial questions

Ben — thanks for the demo earlier. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we prepare an internal ask: can you send a clear pricing breakdown for the observability add-ons (retention windows, tracing ingest, and dashboards)? We run HL7 traffic and care about egress + retention costs. Also our procurement team is asking whether you have any time-limited commercial incentives for pilot/early contracts (e.g., credits, discounts) if we sign within August.

I've attached our high-level requirements (starlane-visibility-requirements.pdf). Please CC our procurement alias so they can track.

— Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Starlane Health

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlanehealth.com>
Cc: procure@starlanehealth.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: initial questions

Alex — really appreciate the detailed requirements. Looping in Kimberly (pricing lead) to confirm a few policy items but wanted to put a concrete straw-man on the table so your team has something to review. High level: we price add-ons across three axes — retention window (30 / 90 / 365 days), tracing (per-ingest + per-trace retention), and advanced dashboards (seat vs query bundles). Below is a concise breakdown and an early-bird option we can offer for August commitments. I attached an editable worksheet (early-bird-pricing-worksheet.xlsx).

Scenario A — Pilot (3 months term, starts on signing):
- Retention: 90-day bucket at $0.025/GB-month (ingest-metered).
- Tracing: $0.12 per 1,000 traces ingested + $0.015/GB-month for indexed trace storage.
- Dashboards: 5 power seats + 1k queries/month included; $50/extra seat, $0.004 per extra query.
- Pilot credit: $15k usage credit applied in first 60 days (one-time).

Early-bird Commercial (sign by 2027-08-31):
- 10% discount across retention and tracing for first 12 months.
- Waive dashboard seat onboarding fee (normally $2k).
- Commitment path: 12-month term with monthly metered billing; we can tailor a minimum monthly commitment if desired.

Open items we need from you to firm up pricing: expected monthly data ingest (GB), peak QPS to dashboards, and whether you want trace indexing for full fidelity or sampled. If you prefer a seat-heavy model we can shift the dashboards pricing to seat-based SKU.

Kimberly — any objections to the early-bird concession above for Starlane?

Next steps: if this looks directionally correct I can convert to an internal quote + SOW and include the PO/DocuSign link.

Thanks — Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attach: early-bird-pricing-worksheet.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlanehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: initial questions

Ben — fine to extend the early-bird concession as proposed (10% on retention/tracing for 12 months + waived onboarding fee) provided: (1) Starlane commits to a 12-month agreement with a minimum monthly commitment of $18k for the add-ons combined, and (2) they agree to a 60-day onboarding plan in the SOW. The pilot credit can remain but will be clawed back if the 12-month commitment isn't fulfilled.

Marissa — FYI on SOW timeline; please prep a draft 60-day onboarding cadence and standard clawback language.

Kim

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlanehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procure@starlanehealth.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: initial questions

Thanks — that's helpful and more concrete than we expected. Two quick clarifications from procurement: (a) can you split retention charges between hot (0–30 days) and warm (31–90 days) with different rates? We have large short-term retention spikes we want optimized, and (b) what is the SLA credit if tracing ingestion lags or dashboard queries exceed SLA latency?

Also procurement prefers a one-page commercial summary for legal (we try to avoid long SOWs in the first pass). If you can produce that + the DocuSign-ready PO, we'll aim to circulate internally this week.

— Alex

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlanehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, procure@starlanehealth.com
Date: 2027-08-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: initial questions

Alex — great, answered inline below and attaching a one-page commercial summary and PO draft.

(a) Hot/warm split option: yes — we can use a two-tier retention model for billing: hot (0–30 days) at $0.035/GB-month, warm (31–90 days) at $0.018/GB-month. We’ll apply the 10% early-bird discount to both tiers for the first 12 months if you sign by 2027-08-31.

(b) SLA & credits: default platform SLA for observability routes is 99.9% for query latency and ingestion availability. Standard crediting: 5% monthly credit for 99.5–99.9%, 15% for <99.5% in a billing month (applied to that month's add-on charges). If Starlane requires tighter SLAs we can price a premium SLA.

Attached: one-page-commercial-summary.pdf (includes early-bird bullets) and a PO draft via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DocuSign-Starlane-PO-55821.

If procurement is comfortable I'll generate an internal quote and SOW with the 60-day onboarding timeline and clawback language as Kimberly requested. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to finalize.

Thanks — Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: one-page-commercial-summary.pdf, starlane-visibility-requirements.pdf (from Alex)
